judged_text: totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which over-counts by one page whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit (should be ceil), so a group with exactly 50 members reports "1/2". An admin viewing a group with exactly 50 (or 100, 150...) members sees a next arrow that is enabled (showingLast compares currentPage 1 to totalPages 2 and finds them unequal); clicking it clamps offset to Math.min(0+50, 50) = 50, fetches a page the server renders as empty, and the admin is left staring at an empty member list labeled page 2/2.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). This makes `showingLast` false on the only real page, enabling `next`. The `next` action sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` (so 50), and `Group.findMembers()` requests `/groups/:name/members.json` with `offset=50`, which the server (`GroupsController#members`) will return as an empty page due to `limit(limit).offset(offset)`. The described empty “page 2/2” behavior is directly implied by the diff.
